title: A thread's criteria and tests list in one order at every face
objective: Each face that lists a thread's criteria or tests orders them as acceptance.md does: the thread's own group first, then each package's group in the package list's order, then any other group by `id::id_order`.
body:
## Rows

Found in Phase 0. On this thread, `intent ac list` orders the package groups by their hex (`5cc0`, `8a37`, ... `efe0`), and acceptance.md orders them by when each package was made (`views::groups`, `intentsvcs/src/views.rs:1441`, issue Ib383ad5). This is Ib383ad5's class of defect, on a face that Ib383ad5 did not reach.

## Deliverables

- One comparator for a label's place in its thread, moved out of `views::groups` to one home in intentsvcs. `views::groups` calls it.
- `Facade::ac_list` (`intentsvcs/src/facade.rs:6608`), `Facade::at_list` (`intentsvcs/src/facade.rs:21574`) and each other face that lists a thread's criteria or tests give their rows in that order.
- The stored order does not change, so no canon file is written again.

## Approach

Sort at the facade's list doors, which the CLI and the MCP faces both read.

## Dependencies

None.

## Risks

A test that asserts the order of `ac list` on git-style groups changes. Ordinal groups keep their order, because a thread's ordinal packages are in the same order by record and by label.

## Verification

Before the bank, the builder runs clippy and critic-rust on its diff.

The batch decides this package: one `bin/devbin gate all` and one `bin/devbin test shell` at main's HEAD, after the last bank lands, booked by vc with the Desk. No gate and no suite runs for this bank alone.

## Seat and size

cc (intentsvcs). S.
